name: Panta curated Freightliner legacy MID/PID/SID/FMI reference
source_note: Curated factual reference derived from the user-supplied Scribd Freightliner Engine Fault Codes Guide (12 pages). The source is an older translated/legacy table and is not an OEM service manual. Preserve its MID/PID/SID terminology, but verify exact vehicle, controller, protocol and current OEM documentation before diagnosis.

documents.title: Freightliner Legacy MID PID SID FMI Reference
documents.summary: The supplied guide identifies MID 128 engine, 130 automatic transmission, 136 ABS, 140 left instrument panel, 142 right instrument panel #1, 172 diagnostic system, 179 logging/black-box system, 181 satellite communications, 190 A/C, 219 VORAD radar, 231 cellular communications and 234 right instrument panel #2. It provides legacy PID, module-specific SID and general FMI tables.

documents.title: Freightliner legacy PID 51-127 parameter mappings
documents.summary: Source mappings include PID 70 park-brake switch; 74 maximum road speed; 84 road/motion speed; 85 cruise status; 89 PTO status; 91 accelerator-pedal position; 92 engine load; 94 fuel-delivery pressure; 95 fuel-filter differential pressure; 96 fuel level; 97 water-in-fuel indication; 98 engine-oil level; 99 oil-filter differential pressure; 100 engine-oil pressure; 101 crankcase pressure; 102 boost pressure; 103 turbo speed; 104 turbo oil pressure; 106 air-inlet pressure; 107 air-filter differential pressure; 108 barometric pressure; 109 coolant pressure; 110 coolant temperature; 111 coolant level; 114 battery current; 115 alternator current; 116 brake application pressure; 117 primary brake reservoir pressure; 118 secondary brake reservoir pressure; 120 retarder oil temperature; 121 engine-retarder status; 123 clutch pressure; and 127 transmission oil pressure.

documents.title: Freightliner legacy PID 154-253 parameter mappings
documents.summary: Source mappings include PID 157 injector-metering/supply pressure; 158 switched battery voltage; 160 mainshaft speed; 161 transmission input-shaft speed; 164 injection-control pressure; 167 alternator voltage; 168 battery voltage; 171 ambient-air temperature; 172 air-inlet temperature; 173 exhaust-gas temperature; 174 fuel temperature; 175 engine-oil temperature; 177 transmission-oil temperature; 183 fuel rate; 186 PTO speed; 188 idle engine speed; 189 rated engine speed; 190 engine speed; 191 transmission output-shaft speed; 237 VIN; 241 tire pressure; 242 tire temperature; 247 total engine hours; 250 total fuel used; 251 clock; 252 date; and 253 ECM elapsed time.

documents.title: MID 128 legacy engine subsystem SID mappings
documents.summary: MID 128 SIDs in the supplied guide include SID 1-16 injector cylinders 1-16; 17 main fuel shutoff valve; 18 fuel-flow control valve; 20 timing actuator; 21 engine/crankshaft position sensor; 22 timing sensor; 23 rack actuator; 24 rack-position sensor; 27 and 28 turbocharger control actuators; 32 wastegate driver; 33 fan-clutch control; 34 exhaust-pressure sensor; 35 exhaust-pressure solenoid; 37 power relay; 39 starter relay; 41 ECM 8-volt supply; 42 injector-pressure regulator; 61 swirl valve; 62 prestroke sensor; 63 prestroke actuator; 64 engine-speed sensor #2; 65 oxygen sensor; 76 knock sensor; 77 gas-metering valve; and 78 fuel-pump control mechanism. Treat these as legacy identifier mappings, not component-failure conclusions.

documents.title: MID 136 ABS subsystem SID mappings
documents.summary: MID 136 ABS mappings include SIDs 1-6 wheel sensors by axle and side: axle 1 left/right, axle 2 left/right and axle 3 left/right. SIDs 7-12 are pressure-modulator valves for the corresponding axle/side positions. The guide continues with ABS/ASR relays, switches, valves, warning lamps, axle-average speed sensing, brake-adjustment indications, solenoids, hydraulic pump, brake-light switches, brake pressure/control, trailer braking, axle-load sensing and brake-pad thickness sensing through SID 80.

documents.title: MID 190 A/C and MID 219 VORAD subsystem mappings
documents.summary: MID 190 A/C subsystem entries include refrigerant level/moisture/non-condensed gas, refrigerant-flow solenoid, low-pressure switch, compressor-clutch circuit and thermostat circuit. MID 219 VORAD entries include front antenna, antenna electronics, brake-system monitor, dynamics monitor, steering-position monitor, speedometer monitor, turn monitors, display and right/left/rear sensors.

documents.title: How Panta should interpret legacy Freightliner codes
documents.summary: For legacy MID/PID/SID/FMI displays, identify the reporting module (MID), then the parameter or subsystem (PID/SID), then use the FMI to understand the reported failure mode. Do not diagnose from PID or SID alone. Record whether the fault is active or stored, exact vehicle/year/engine/controller, symptoms, recent repairs and related faults. This supplied guide is an older translated table and can contain ambiguous wording, so use it as an identification aid and verify repair procedures/specifications against appropriate OEM information.
